mood.label: CAUTIOUS
mood.line: Prices are rising too fast, so the Fed may raise rates.

assets.why: Money usually flows into stocks while the economy grows.
Gold usually climbs when savings pay less after inflation.
The dollar usually falls when money looks abroad for better returns.
Bond payouts usually rise while the economy runs warm.

bullets: Prices: steady at about 3.7% a year. The Fed wants 2%.
Jobs: hiring has slowed to about +20K a month.
Next big date: Jobs report on Sep 4.
